Format insights as:

context: <when this applies>

[LEARN]
insight: The task was vague ("No tests detected") - no specific file or component mentioned, making it a low-value suggestion rather than actionable task
context: When inter-review generates generic suggestions without actionable details
[/LEARN]

[LEARN]
insight: 792 PAUSED tasks represent accumulated technical debt from stuck/stalled task processing
context: System health metrics show many tasks stuck in PAUSED state long-term
[/LEARN]

[LEARN]
insight: Inter-review scored 70/100 but produced vague generic suggestion - suggests scoring criteria may need refinement to generate more specific feedback
context: When review suggestions lack actionable specificity
[/LEARN]

[ISSUE]
title: 792 PAUSED tasks never clearing type: bug severity: medium
[/ISSUE]

[PROMPT_UPDATE]
insight: Inter-review suggestions should include specific file paths or component names, not generic statements
context: When generating review findings for task processing
[/PROMPT_UPDATE]
